CustomObject.description: Landing zone for bulk consent loads from an external ETL tool (Informatica, MuleSoft, Data Loader). The ETL job writes here with no business logic attached; ConsentStagingBatch validates and promotes the rows asynchronously. Decoupling the load from the processing means a failed transform never leaves half-applied consent in the live object, and the ETL job never has to understand Salesforce validation rules.
CustomObject.label: Consent Staging
